title: PlanReviewEngineRouteOutput
description: OUTPUT of `plan_review_engine_route`: `run_pipeline` is true iff the DET floor passed (run_llm) AND the engine is `pipeline`; `run_agentic` likewise for `agentic`. The review branches read them.

run_pipeline.description: True iff run_llm and engine == pipeline → run the four-pass pipeline review.

run_agentic.description: True iff run_llm and engine == agentic → run the agentic review.
